say:1:1320202101:1.text: As a snowman, my duty is to play in the snow and allow others to enjoy it too!
say:1:1320202101:1.source_cn: 作为雪人，玩雪和让别人玩雪就是我的使命！
say:1:1320202101:1.male: As a snowman, my duty is to play in the snow and allow others to enjoy it too!
say:1:1320202101:1.female: As a snowman, my duty is to play in the snow and allow others to enjoy it too!

say:2:1320202102:1.text: The snowball fight is the most iconic and fun game during winter!
say:2:1320202102:1.source_cn: 雪球大战是最经典、最快乐的玩法！
say:2:1320202102:1.male: The snowball fight is the most iconic and fun game during winter!
say:2:1320202102:1.female: The snowball fight is the most iconic and fun game during winter!

say:3:1320202103:1.source_cn: 所以，来陪我一起雪球大战吧！
